subject.title: [Feature]: Add before_persistence_write hook for durable state changes

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated `before_persistence_write` Plugin SDK hook, or should durable-write policy be represented by richer existing tool/action metadata instead?
rationale: This is a public security-sensitive Plugin SDK contract; the current issue deliberately leaves unresolved taxonomy, mutation, and complementary read-hook questions that automation should not choose.

options.title: Design dedicated persistence hook
options.body: Add a new public hook for durable write attempts with a narrow payload and focused representative write-path coverage.

options.title: Extend existing tool-call context
options.body: Keep one pre-tool-call enforcement path and add durable-write classification/provenance fields instead of a separate event.

options.title: Defer to broader provenance work
options.body: Hold this issue until the linked cross-session provenance proposal defines how persisted state carries trust metadata.

recommendation.title: Design dedicated persistence hook
recommendation.body: Add a new public hook for durable write attempts with a narrow payload and focused representative write-path coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent Plugin SDK and hook-surface history makes this the best available routing candidate for the product/API direction choice.
